// Features

More than code completion.
A coding partner that gets things done

CodeFlux chains planning, coding, debugging and testing into one pipeline. You just confirm the result.

Autonomous task execution

Give it a goal and the agent breaks it into steps, reads and writes files, runs commands and fixes its own errors. Every step can be reviewed and undone, so you stay in control.

❯ codeflux "migrate this project from Vue 2 to Vue 3"
→ Scanned 128 components · plan generated · ~46 files to change
→ Done 46/46 · build passed · waiting for your diff review

Whole-project understanding

Builds a local code index so even million-line repos resolve context in seconds. Ask "where is this function called?"

Local-first · Private

Code and sessions stay on your computer by default. Bring your own API key, or run fully offline with local models.

Multi-agent collaboration

Planner, coder, tester and reviewer divide the work and advance complex tasks in parallel, with steadier quality.

Built-in terminal & preview

Run scripts, start services and preview web pages live, without juggling multiple windows.

MCP & plugin ecosystem

Connect databases, GitHub, Figma, browsers and more through the MCP protocol. Capabilities scale without limit.

GitHubMySQLFigmaBrowserDocker

Frontend, backend, mobile and data scripts all covered, and it follows the conventions and style of your project.

// How it works

Four steps, from idea to launch

No complex setup. Install it, open a project folder, and you're ready.

01

Describe

Say what you want in plain language. Attach screenshots, docs or error messages if you like.

02

Plan

CodeFlux analyzes the codebase and drafts an editable plan. It starts only after you confirm.

03

Execute

Writes code, runs commands and tests, and locates and fixes errors automatically.

04

Review & ship

Review line by line in a clear diff view, then accept, roll back or commit to Git in one click.

// FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is CodeFlux? How is it different from ordinary AI code completion?

CodeFlux is an AI coding agent for macOS, Windows and Linux. Unlike tools that only complete a few lines, it understands the whole project, plans tasks on its own, reads and writes multiple files, runs terminal commands and tests, and fixes errors automatically, finishing the whole job like a real engineer.

How do I try it for free?

Just download and install CodeFlux. The Free plan has no time limit and needs no credit card. Connect your own API key or a local model to start.

Is my code uploaded? Is it safe?

Nothing is uploaded proactively. Project files, indexes and session history are stored locally. Only when you call a cloud model is the context relevant to the current task sent to the model provider you chose. You can also use local models to work fully offline.

Which models are supported?

50+ providers including DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Doubao, Claude, GPT and Gemini, plus local models via Ollama / LM Studio. Switch freely per task.

How much does CodeFlux cost?

Downloading CodeFlux and using the core agent is free. Pro is $20 per month (or $192 per year) and adds parallel agents, project memory and checkpoints. It is prepaid, does not renew automatically and is refundable within 7 days. For Team and Enterprise, contact us. See the Pricing page for details.

How do I get help?

Read the official docs or email support@routok.com. Pro includes priority email support, and Enterprise customers get dedicated support.
